class.name: NetwRingBuffer
class.brief_description: Stores values by tick, with a fixed capacity.

method.name: bracketing_ticks
method.description: Returns the recorded ticks around [param tick]. [code]x[/code] is the newest at or before it, and [code]y[/code] the oldest after it, or [code]-1[/code] when there is none.

method.name: create
method.description: Returns a buffer holding at least [param capacity] values, rounded up to a power of two. [code]new()[/code] holds 16.

method.name: get_at
method.description: Returns the value at [param tick], or [code]null[/code].

method.name: has_tick_after
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when at least one entry is recorded strictly after [param tick].

method.name: newest_tick
method.description: Returns the most recently recorded tick, or [code]-1[/code] when the buffer is empty.

method.name: oldest_tick
method.description: Returns the oldest recorded tick, or [code]-1[/code] when the buffer is empty.

method.name: record
method.description: Records [param value] at [param tick], replacing any value already there. When full, the oldest value is removed.

method.name: size
method.description: Returns how many values are recorded.
